notes.title: UPDATE 1.5 - Koi Jam
notes.notes:
[IMG]http://i.imgur.com/yp0e4Sm.gif[/IMG]

Have fun jamming the Koi into the Shishi-Odashi (water feature).

 [h1] Changes: [/h1]
 [list]
    [*]Koi can now be used to silence the Shishi-Odashi.
    [*]Puzzle 1 wont restart (fixed).
    [*]Shishi-Odashi tip frequency extended.
    [*]A few other minor fixes.
[/list]
Enjoy!!!!

notes.title: NEW PUZZLE UPDATE!!!
notes.notes:
[img]http://i.imgur.com/Q7bjbWy.png[/img]

Thanks to everyone who has supported us in our new puzzle series, we are now pleased to present you all with the first of many extra puzzles.

We have added the first FREE DLC additional puzzle update to Pixel Puzzle: Japan today.

We have also lowered the sound of the Shishi-Odashi (water fountain) to where 
it should no longer bother those who find it annoying.

Enjoy!!!!
